questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe cloud computing
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: What is cloud computing
questions.question: Which statement best describes Cloud computing?

options.text: The ability to obtain computing capacity rapidly instead of waiting for physical infrastructure procurement
The delivery of computing services over the internet
Technology that helps manage Azure, on-premises, hybrid, and multicloud resources through a consistent management approach
The cloud service model that leaves the most operational responsibility with the customer

questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: Virtual machines: managed or hosted database capabilities delivered through a cloud platform.
Virtual machines: compute resources that can be delivered as cloud services instead of requiring local physical servers.

Cloud computing: the delivery of computing services over the internet.
